data.title: Stewards Inc Amends Loan Agreement and Warrant Terms
data.description:
Stewards Inc ( (SWRD) ) has issued an announcement.

On September 3, 2026, Stewards, Inc. amended its September 17, 2025 loan agreement with Stewards International Funds PCC, extending the facility closing date from August 31, 2026 to November 15, 2026 while maintaining the $100 million limit, 8.00% annual interest rate and August 31, 2030 maturity, and confirming that notes issued remain unsecured and unsubordinated. The amendment reduces warrant coverage on principal funded after August 31, 2026 to one facility warrant per $3.00, requires all earned warrants to be issued by November 15, 2026, and keeps the warrant exercise price at $0.76 per share, with related-party chairman Glen Steward recusing himself and disinterested directors approving the deal as fair to the company and its shareholders.

The facility warrants issued for principal advanced under the loan will be exercisable for restricted shares of common stock at $0.76 per share after the later of the August 31, 2030 maturity date or a liquidity event and for three years thereafter, and will rely on private offering exemptions, limiting immediate resale and adding a structured equity-like component to the company’s funding mix. While the amendment itself does not advance new principal or automatically issue warrants, it lengthens the window in which additional obligations and corresponding warrant grants may arise, potentially affecting capital structure and dilution depending on how much funding the company draws during the extended period.
